display.purpose: Page h1 / hero titles in Hopkins Navy. Restrained, max ~2.25rem.

body.purpose: Reading and data-cell text in Archive Ink, capped 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase metadata labels for toolbars and table heads only.

mono.purpose: AUIDs, hashes, exact identifiers — the archive call-number.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard/interaction focus only. No ambient resting shadows.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default 0.15-0.2s state transitions (hover, tab underline, disclosure caret).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call-to-action per view. Hopkins Navy fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #002d72; color: #fff; font-family: Lato, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #002d72; border-radius: 0.35rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #001a45; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(0,45,114,0.25); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default secondary / row-level action. Paper fill, navy stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: #002d72; font-family: Lato, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid #002d72; border-radius: 0.35rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #002d72; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(0,45,114,0.25); }

components.name: Composition Chip
components.description: Data token summarizing an element and its ratio. The only sanctioned pill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; background: #fff; color: #1a1510; font-family: Lato, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid rgba(0,45,114,0.2); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-chip-ratio { font-weight: 400; color: rgba(26,21,16,0.7); }

components.name: Affiliation Badge
components.description: Encoding badge — solid fill in the affiliation hue, always with its label.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: #002d72; color: #fff; font-family: Lato, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.35rem; }

components.name: AUID
components.description: The record call-number: monospace, navy, tight tracking.
components.css: .ds-auid { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #002d72; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Flat bordered surface. Toolbar header + body. No resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(26,21,16,0.1); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; color: #1a1510; font-family: Lato, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-toolbar { padding: 1rem 1.15rem; background: rgba(0,45,114,0.03); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(26,21,16,0.08); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: rgba(49,38,29,0.5); } .ds-panel-body { padding: 1rem 1.15rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Paper fill, grey stroke, small radius, visible focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fff; color: #1a1510; font-family: Lato, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 0.35rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #002d72; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0,45,114,0.2); }

components.name: Detail Tab
components.description: Text tab with a 2px navy underline when active — never boxed or pill.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(26,21,16,0.1); } .ds-tab { padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem; font-family: Lato, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; color: rgba(26,21,16,0.58); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #002d72; } .ds-tab.is-active { color: #002d72; border-bottom-color: #002d72; }

narrative.overview: LOOP is the authoritative catalog of a university-and-national-lab materials consortium, and it should carry itself that way: serious, exact, and permanent. The metaphor is a great research archive — every record has a call number (its AUID), the structure of the catalog is itself trustworthy, and nothing is dressed up because the material is the point. Density is a feature, earned through hierarchy rather than cramming. The refined detail-page language — gradient hero banner, monospace call-numbers, underline tabs, flat bordered panels — is the target the rest of the platform grows toward, replacing older Bootstrap-plus-SCSS drift with one coherent hand.
keyCharacteristics: Institutional navy as signature, spent deliberately — never as a background wash.
Monospace AUIDs treated as call-numbers: the identity of every record.
Color is a data encoding (affiliation, structure family) before it is ever decoration.
Flat, bordered surfaces; depth comes from tone and line, not shadow.
Dense but ordered — hierarchy carries the load, not cramming.

rules.name: The One Navy Rule
rules.body: Hopkins Navy is the single institutional voice — authority (headings, AUIDs, affiliation) and action (primary buttons, active states) only. If navy fills large decorative areas, it has been spent wrong.

rules.name: The Encoding Rule
rules.body: Structure-family and affiliation hues belong to data. Never reuse them for buttons, backgrounds, or ornament — it breaks the reader's learned color-to-meaning mapping.

rules.name: The Call-Number Rule
rules.body: Every AUID, hash, and machine-exact identifier is set in monospace. Prose is never monospace; identifiers are never prose.

rules.name: The Quiet Display Rule
rules.body: Display type maxes out near 2.25rem. LOOP never uses oversized hero type — an institution states, it doesn't advertise.

rules.name: The Line-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation between surfaces is drawn with a 1px hairline and a tonal shift, not a drop shadow. A shadow may appear only in response to focus, hover-on-interactive, or a raised layer.

dos: Do spend Hopkins Navy (#002d72) only on authority and action — headings, primary buttons, active states, AUIDs, S4E affiliation. Keep it off large backgrounds.
Do set every AUID, hash, and exact identifier in the monospace family (the Call-Number Rule).
Do always pair an encoding color with its text label; assume a colorblind reader and never rely on hue alone.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and tonal washes; keep resting surfaces shadow-free (the Line-Not-Shadow Rule).
Do present many records as data tables with right-aligned numerics and mono AUIDs.
Do keep the small radius vocabulary — 0.35rem actions/inputs, 8-12px panels, 999px for data chips only.
Do provide honest loading, empty, and error states — Rietveld and batch jobs are slow and synchronous; always say what's happening.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no decorative gradient heroes, no violet/purple accent, no glassmorphism, no endless icon-card grids.
Don't slip back into the cluttered legacy academic look: no text-align: justify body copy, no hairline border-bottom on an h2 as a substitute for real hierarchy, no undifferentiated blue link-soup.
Don't go consumer or playful: no bubbly oversized radii, no candy color, no gamified flourishes, no mascot energy.
Don't reuse structure-family or affiliation hues for buttons, backgrounds, or ornament — that color belongs to data (the Encoding Rule).
Don't nest a card inside a card, or use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't oversize display type past ~2.25rem or use gradient text; emphasis comes from weight and navy, not spectacle.
Don't remove focus outlines or convey state (error, success, selected) through color alone.
